# solid-v1.4

solid-v1.3 that counts line length through crossings (the arms of an X) and extends line ends into a feature they run into.

Status: **superseded** (replaced by a newer version, kept so older packs can be rebuilt)  
Changes in this version: Line length counted through crossings; line ends reach into a feature they run into.  
Based on: [solid-v1.3](solid-v1.3.md)  
Built on this: [solid-v1.5](solid-v1.5.md)  

Not used by any built-in profile (pick it with `--blocks`, `--items` or `--use`).

## What it changes

Compared with solid-v1.3:

| option | solid-v1.3 | solid-v1.4 |
|---|---|---|
| `line_thru` | `False` | `True` |
| `line_reach` | `False` | `True` |
